title: Fairy Buns
text: “This turned out to be a fine result for the training camp meant to help those who’d fallen a bit behind, wouldn’t you say?”

On the last night of our stay on the island, we all gathered in the hotel’s observation room to chat while watching the night view, I say. Rival said we didn’t need to deal with the Spirit Tortoise’s cave business, so we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves, indeed.

“That’s right. This place turned out to be more of a training ground than an entertainment spot, so there was less fun stuff than I expected—which means there’s plenty of room for businesses like circuses to move in. Good to know.”

By the way, there was a separate-fee tour to go see the risen island, and it seemed the island itself was under management, I say. Apparently, since the heroes were investigating it, sneaking in without permission would get you fined, and security was being maintained. Well, even so, there were plenty of trespassers, but nobody without a hero could get into the main building. Anyway, the event held on the island wrapped up without any particular trouble. Also, Ren made his food-stall debut as the Dark Culinary Master Cerberus alongside Keel and Yuki-chan.
“Emia-san was worried the whole time about whether she was allowed such extravagance, just as I imagined.”
“Did it go well? I was playing with Imiya-chan according to plan on my end.”
“……Yes, she reported to me that she bowed her head, apologizing in case Naofumi-san’s slaves had been intimidating her, and asked that they get along.”
“She was kind of scared of us, huh. Wolf spent the whole time on the island running around in peckul form for fun.”
“Thanks to that, Emia-san held back less and had a meaningful time. I also gave Rishia-san a costume, which made it easier for her to talk with Motoyasu-san.”
“I see.”
Then Father, wearing a somewhat amused smile, asked Itsuki—
“Did you manage to have some fun with Emia-san?”
“You sound just like Sadeena-san… honestly, your reactions in that department are eerily similar.”
“Th-that so?”

“Well, I did get to enjoy myself a little. I have zero confidence I can make her happy, but if pushing self-deprecation to its limit means throwing away happiness, then I have to make her happy no matter what.”
Itsuki seemed to be pushing pretty hard on Mole, it seemed.
“Still, unless Naofumi-san makes Imiya-san happy first, she’ll keep her guard up too tightly……”
“Ahaha…… well, Imiya-chan works hard, so I do plan to thank her properly.”
Mole had already learned dressmaking as her job within the circus, I say. She’d also been helping build circus contraptions and the like.
“I developed the island’s signature dish!”
Ren held up a kitchen knife and presented the fairy buns that Father had developed, I say.
“R-Ren—Cerberus, I mean—glad you had fun with it.”
“Wasn’t the model for this something Naofumi-san made?”
“To be precise, Lars-chan said, ‘Why not sell buns modeled after the natives?’ so I did some test batches in the kitchen. It’s honestly strange there wasn’t something like that already.”
“Apparently there used to be something similar. But since nobody remembers what the natives officially looked like anymore, it turned into something else entirely.”
Ah, they were selling something like ordinary sweet buns, I say. Was that the one?
“Now then, the training camp’s wrapping up, but…… do you both understand where you’re not allowed to go once we leave the island, Ren, Itsuki?”
“Yes, that we mustn’t undo the Spirit Tortoise’s seal, correct?”
“Not interested. That’s just Sword Hero rumor territory anyway.”
Father made a troubled face at Ren’s response, I say.
“Fufufufu…… let’s call this brief respite over. Starting tomorrow, the days of battle continue as I search for a companion to drag down into hell with me.”
“Just eat your bun and hush, Itsuki…… sigh. For a type like Emia-san, maybe it’d be more effective if I asked her directly myself.”
“Wait, what exactly are you planning to ask Emia-san? Depending on your answer, even you, Naofumi-san, won’t be forgiven.”
“‘Fill Itsuki with happiness and make him forget about fighting—that’s your atonement!’ Something like that.”
“Guh…… are you trying to hit my weak point exactly?! I won’t let you, aaaargh!”
So saying, Itsuki pointed his fist at Father but couldn’t actually do anything, just stomping his feet in frustration.
“I really do want you to remember what happiness feels like, Itsuki. As much as Ren does, ideally.”
“Sword Hero isn’t happy, woof! He’s just praised for being mysteriously edgy, woof!”
“Ah, geez, this is such a pain……”
“Wait, more importantly, Motoyasu-san! Why are you being so quiet?! It’s exactly when you go silent and just stare over here that I hate the most!”
Stat-tan! Itsuki took a shot at me, so I dodged it, indeed.
“Well, when Motoyasu-kun goes quiet, it does feel like he’s hiding something sometimes, so it’s definitely worth worrying about. There was that usaunny incident too.”
“There’s nothing in particular, pyon. If anything, isn’t it more likely Rafumi’s scheming something evil, pyon?”
“Well, that person does tend to have the attitude that anything’s fine as long as it’s entertaining.”
“Guess it can’t be helped that we’re on guard…… well, without relying on strategy guides, let’s just prioritize our own decisions except for the places we’re told not to go.”
“In Naofumi-san’s case, which route is it? Mole’s, right? What about Imiya-san?”

“Somehow you get old-you vibes only in this specific area, Itsuki…… feels a little off though…… well, regarding Imiya-chan, I’ve made promises with the Rumo-species folks too, so eventually, you know.”
Father seemed to have started scheming to soak Itsuki thoroughly in Mole, I say. He apparently wanted to sink him in happiness and get him to wash his hands of that grim, bloodthirsty lifestyle.

“Well, Itsuki, why don’t you interact with the Rumo-species people, and work together with Theodore, Rishia-san, and Gaelion-chan? It sounds like they’ll arrange things to some extent according to what you want to do. Just make sure you treasure Emia-san and the others, alright?”
“Yes.”
“R—Cerberus, well, just have fun with Keel-kun and the others, and come visit the village sometimes, alright?”
“Yeah!”
“Motoyasu-kun, behave yourself. Well, maybe you can help raise everyone’s overall strength. We need to calm the waves over in Siltvelt and go pay our respects in Faubrey too.”
“Yes, I say, pyon!”
And so, that night on Cal Mira Island, we reconfirmed our plans going forward.

And so, having finished our vacation on Cal Mira Island, we returned and scattered to various places, continuing the fight to calm the waves, I say. Around the time the Spirit Tortoise incident broke out, in the first world, after challenging and quelling waves in each country, we helped with the reconstruction of Big Sister’s village and so on, indeed. Amid all that…… Fleon-chan seemed to be visiting Sage’s place and moving around various parts of Melromarc quite a bit. It seemed there was someone she was interested in, since she’d started going out often. She’s strong enough now that the chance of her being attacked is low, indeed. As for problems, well—it seemed the deteriorating public order within Melromarc had become a point of consultation from Éclair and others to Father. Naturally, it seemed Ren, or rather Rafumi, was also being asked to help maintain public order. Well, in situations like that, all you can do is deal with the sparks as they fall on you, I say. And so, amid such days—Rival, Rabbit Guy, and Itsuki, who had gone off to Shieldfreeden, returned for a bit.
“Ah, welcome back, Itsuki. How was Shieldfreeden? Gaelion-chan said she’d show you some darkness, right?”

“That’s right…… there are truly hopeless people among both the Demi-Humans and the Beastmen. They’ve utterly misunderstood what freedom really means. Fufu…… Melromarc was full of nothing but petty crooks, but I found some worthy opponents there and I’m enjoying myself.”
“I-is that so……”

“Yeah…… honestly, it’s almost amusing how there’s a town that’s nothing but corruption. Takt, was it? Many of the people there seem to be under his influence, but it’s interesting. To think there are scoundrels that far gone.”
He laughed with a “kusu,” and somehow his expression seemed lighter.
“Well, as heroes of justice, they’re opponents we can crush without any regrets. What’s more, it seems they’ve newly connected with some people called the Reincarnators.”
Rabbit Guy answered with a slightly exasperated tone as well.
“So is Itsuki flying around the town at night in the outfit Gaelion-chan prepared for him?”

Apparently Itsuki had been flying around the town of Shieldfreeden in a new uniform, catching villains one after another. This much was within expectations, indeed. After all, even back when Itsuki went to Faubrey, catching villains was exactly the kind of work he’d been doing.
“That’s right. There’s no end to the petty crooks either—catch one, catch another, it never stops, truly…… hopeless.”
Saying this, Itsuki laughed more brightly than before, indeed. It could also be called a wicked smile.
